mgmt_bio.text: Zhang Yi is president of China Construction Bank, one of China's largest state-owned commercial banks. He has served as president since May 2024, as an executive director since June 2024 and as vice chairman of the board since July 2024, and he has also been chairman of Sino-German Bausparkasse since January 2025. Before joining CCB, he was an executive vice president at Bank of China from March 2023 to May 2024 and at Agricultural Bank of China from November 2021 to March 2023.
